item.title: FCC Approves Paramount‑Skydance Gulf Sovereign Deal
item.description: The FCC gave Paramount‑Skydance a waiver, letting Saudi, UAE and Qatari funds own 49.5% and help finance its $111 B Warner Bros. Discovery deal.

item.title: FCC Waives Foreign Ownership Rule for Paramount‑Warner
item.description: The FCC grants a 49.5% equity waiver to Saudi, Qatari and Abu Dhabi funds in the Paramount‑Warner merger, raising regulatory and geopolitical concerns.

item.title: ABC & Disney Sue FCC Over Retaliatory Campaign
item.description: ABC and Disney have filed a federal lawsuit accusing the FCC of a retaliatory campaign that threatens broadcast licenses over political content.

item.title: Trump Nominee Gives FCC Historic 3‑1 Republican Majority
item.description: President Trump nominates Danielle Thumann Severs, creating the FCC’s 3‑1 Republican majority and reshaping telecom policy before Senate confirmation.

item.title: US Approves Mirror Satellite
item.description: US FCC authorizes Reflect Orbital to launch mirror satellite Eärendil-1

item.title: Space Mirror Launch Cleared
item.description: US FCC clears launch of Eärendil-1, a sunlight reflecting space mirror, amid concerns over optical astronomy impact

item.title: FCC Commissioner Anna Gomez
item.description: FCC Commissioner Anna Gomez fights for press freedom against censorship
